text: It is undeniable that a teenager in Almaty today may wear the same trainers, watch the same series and use the same apps as a teenager in London or Seoul. I agree that globalisation is making everyday life more uniform, but I do not believe that local traditions and languages are destined to disappear.

There is strong evidence that global culture is spreading. International chains have replaced many local cafés and shops, and young people increasingly consume films and music produced in a handful of countries, mostly in English. As a result, certain local practices, such as traditional crafts or regional dialects, are practised by fewer people each generation, and some have already been lost.

However, the claim that local cultures will soon vanish ignores two important trends. Firstly, the same technology that spreads global culture also helps to protect local heritage. Musicians who combine traditional instruments with modern styles can now reach millions of listeners online, and language apps have encouraged a revival of interest in minority languages, including Kazakh. Secondly, people rarely replace their identity entirely; instead, they tend to combine global habits with local ones, celebrating national holidays and family customs while enjoying international entertainment.

It is also worth noting that cultures have always borrowed from each other. What looks like a loss from one perspective may simply be the latest stage of a long process of exchange, in which traditions adapt rather than die.

In conclusion, while globalisation has undoubtedly made many countries more alike on the surface, I disagree that local traditions and languages will soon disappear. Provided that communities continue to value and use them, they are more likely to evolve than to vanish.

strengths.en: The task has two claims; the writer accepts one and challenges the other — an exact answer to “To what extent”.
strengths.kk: Тапсырмада екі тұжырым бар — автор біреуімен келісіп, екіншісімен дауласады. Бұл «To what extent» сұрағына дәл жауап.
strengths.ru: В задании два утверждения — автор соглашается с одним и спорит со вторым. Это точный ответ на «To what extent».
strengths.example: I agree that globalisation is making everyday life more uniform

strengths.en: The writer first admits the strength of the opposing evidence.
strengths.kk: Автор алдымен қарсы дәлелдердің күшін мойындайды.
strengths.ru: Автор сначала признаёт силу противоположных доказательств.
strengths.example: There is strong evidence that global culture is spreading

strengths.en: Kazakh as an example makes an abstract argument concrete.
strengths.kk: Қазақ тілі мысалы абстрактілі дәлелді нақты етеді.
strengths.ru: Казахский язык как пример делает абстрактный довод конкретным.
strengths.example: encouraged a revival of interest in minority languages, including Kazakh

strengths.en: The idea of cultural exchange lifts the essay above a simple for-and-against.
strengths.kk: Мәдени алмасу идеясы эссені жай «жақтау / қарсы» деңгейінен жоғары көтереді.
strengths.ru: Идея о культурном обмене поднимает эссе выше простого «за / против».

note.en: Introduction: a vivid example and a precise degree of agreement — yes to the first claim, no to the second.
note.kk: Кіріспе: жарқын мысал және келісімнің дәл дәрежесі — бірінші бөлігімен келісемін, екіншісімен жоқ.
note.ru: Введение: яркий пример и точная степень согласия — согласен с первой частью, не согласен со второй.

note.en: Concession: evidence that globalisation really does make life more uniform.
note.kk: Мойындау: жаһанданудың өмірді шынымен біркелкі ететінінің дәлелдері.
note.ru: Уступка: доказательства того, что глобализация действительно унифицирует жизнь.

note.en: The main counter-argument: two trends marked Firstly / Secondly, with Kazakh as an example.
note.kk: Басты қарсы дәлел: Firstly / Secondly деп нөмірленген екі үрдіс, қазақ тілі мысалымен.
note.ru: Главный контраргумент: две тенденции, пронумерованные Firstly / Secondly, с примером казахского языка.

note.en: An extra idea: cultures have always borrowed — a “loss” may be development.
note.kk: Қосымша ой: мәдениеттер әрқашан алмасқан — «жоғалту» даму болуы мүмкін.
note.ru: Дополнительная мысль: культуры всегда заимствовали — «потеря» может быть развитием.

note.en: The conclusion restates the position with a condition.
